questions.stem: A 33-year teacher presents with an 8-week history of synovitis affecting both wrists and the second and third MCP joints of both hands as well as an effusion of the left knee. She remains symptomatic despite 150 mg daily of diclofenac. There is a family history of Rheumatoid Arthritis in a maternal aunt. Investigations ordered by her GP are as follows; Investigation Result Normal range Hb 10.9 x 109/L 12-16 x 109/L WCC 5.6 x 109/L 3-10 x 109/L Platelets 510 x 109/L 150-450 x 109/L Rheumatoid Factor 350 units ANA negative CRP 56 mg/L ESR 75 mm/hr 0-10 Radiographs of the hands and feet demonstrate juxta-articular osteopenia and erosions at the base of the second MCP joints on both hands. What is the most appropriate initial treatment?
